findings.title: Admin typecheck and production build fail on AdminShell session nullability
findings.problem: pnpm --filter @eckamcreation/admin typecheck exits 2. pnpm --filter @eckamcreation/admin build (and root pnpm build) fail the same way: tsc TS18047 on session.name / session.email because session is typed StaffSession | null after the loading-branch change.
findings.evidence: apps/admin/src/components/admin-shell.tsx lines 137 and 143; commands: pnpm --filter @eckamcreation/admin typecheck (exit 2); pnpm -r build / admin next build: Failed to type check.
findings.impact: Typecheck and production build gates fail. Decision rule forbids GO.
findings.suggested_fix: Narrow session before rendering authenticated chrome (if (!session) return loading/confirming; or session?.name / session?.email).

findings.title: Invalid product slug returns HTTP 200
findings.problem: GET /shop/qa-scan-unknown-slug-zzz returned 200 on the running Next dev server. Source calls notFound().
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm next start returns 404; if not, ensure the not-found boundary is used.

findings.title: Invalid collection slug returns HTTP 200
findings.problem: GET /collections/qa-scan-unknown-collection returned 200 and CollectionNotFound UI without notFound().
findings.suggested_fix: Call notFound() when collection is null.

findings.title: Sitemap and canonical URLs use localhost because NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset
findings.problem: GET /sitemap.xml is 200 with 9 loc tags on localhost. Public pages emit canonical http://localhost:3000.
findings.evidence: sitemap 200, 9 loc tags, localhost true; remaining-scan.json seo.*.canonical = http://localhost:3000; siteUrl() fallback.
findings.impact: Production must set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL or sitemap/canonical will advertise localhost.
findings.suggested_fix: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to the canonical https origin in production.

findings.title: Cart, checkout, and account HTML emit robots index,follow
findings.problem: robots.txt correctly disallows /account /cart /checkout, but page meta robots on those routes is index, follow.
findings.evidence: remaining-scan.json seo./cart.robots, seo./checkout.robots = index, follow; robots.txt disallow measured PASS.
findings.impact: Conflicting signals if a crawler ignores robots.txt.
findings.suggested_fix: Set noindex metadata on account, cart, checkout, login, and signup.

findings.title: Checkout client stayed on loading skeleton in the scan browser
findings.problem: After 8+ seconds, /checkout still showed only CHECKOUT chrome plus skeleton bars (h1=0). /cart on the same tab rendered the empty-cart state. HTTP GET /checkout is 200 and API checkout is paymentReady=false.
findings.evidence: Browser CDP innerText='CHECKOUT', 6 skeleton nodes, nextjs-portal overlay present (dev). Cart route OBSERVED empty state. API S6-CHECKOUT 201 ready=false.
findings.impact: Empty-cart checkout UI honesty could not be confirmed in the browser. API path still rejects unpaid completion.
findings.suggested_fix: If cart.status stays loading, surface the empty/error state; verify production-mode hydration without the Next overlay.

findings.title: .env.example ships a copy-paste ADMIN_PASSWORD placeholder
findings.problem: ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-min-8-chars is a default-looking value that could be copied unchanged into production. AUTH_SECRET is empty (correct). Bootstrap skips passwords shorter than 8 characters, but this placeholder is 8+ characters.
findings.evidence: .env.example line ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-min-8-chars; docs/launch/ENV.md notes the placeholder.
findings.impact: A careless copy to production would create a known bootstrap password if no staff exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Leave ADMIN_PASSWORD empty in the example and document that operators must generate a unique value.

findings.title: favicon.ico returns 404; icon.svg returns 200
findings.problem: GET /favicon.ico → 404. GET /icon.svg → 200. Web production build lists /icon.svg.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a favicon.ico or redirect it to icon.svg.

findings.title: GET/POST /v1/search is not implemented (501)
findings.problem: Reserved search routes return notImplemented 501. Storefront search uses GET /v1/catalogue/products?q= and /search is HTTP 200.
findings.impact: Clients that call /v1/search directly get 501. Storefront search still works.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement /v1/search or document it as reserved and keep storefront on catalogue q=.

findings.title: Vitest left extra customer rows (not qa-scan prefix)
findings.problem: Phase 0 customer count was 67. After pnpm test, count is 76. Nine ai_*@example.com users created at 2026-10-05T04:27 remain. Catalogue 11/8 and orders 0 are unchanged. This scan's qa-scan- prefix leftover is 0.
findings.evidence: IDs: cmuur1csd0004utt0nhygoj6f, cmuur1cmf000but4smn13uih2, cmuur1clp0000utt065fl97br, cmuur1ch90007ut4smwmtsona, cmuur19mr0002utw8w7iod06h, cmuur19t00008utw85t6vhloh, cmuur19m60000utw8evmynhlu, cmuur18sy0001uta8utdhzobz, cmuur0wzf0000utn048qqp6u3
findings.impact: Local customer count drift. No catalogue or order damage. Cleanup skipped because emails are not qa-scan- prefixed.
findings.suggested_fix: Tighten test afterAll deletes; operators may delete those IDs locally.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /account main content did not render a login gate
findings.problem: GET /account is 200. Browser showed header/footer only (no h1, no login form). Header still has Sign in. API GET /v1/me unauth is 401 (no data leak).
findings.evidence: Browser CDP on /account: h1=[], innerText is nav/footer only.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated visitors see an empty account chrome until client JS finishes. Data is not leaked.
findings.suggested_fix: SSR a sign-in prompt or redirect unauthenticated /account to /account/login.
